headline: Bitcoin is holding near $73,700 as futures markets price in a Fed rate hike in December, while MSCI's decision to drop Strategy from its indexes weighs on the biggest corporate bitcoin buyer.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $74,000 as a December rate hike looks almost certain
stories.summary: Bitcoin and ether slipped in Asian trading on Thursday after Tuesday's hotter-than-expected US inflation report. Futures markets now price a Fed rate hike at the 9 December meeting as all but certain, and the US dollar is at its strongest in about 19 months. Higher rates make savings and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto.
points: In Asian trading bitcoin slipped 0.9% to $73,617.58 and ether fell 0.9% to $2,049.44, per Business Standard.
CME FedWatch shows an 87.3% chance of a quarter-point December hike and 12.7% for a half-point hike, per Business Standard.
The dollar index held at 102.87, its highest since 9 April last year, per Business Standard.
October consumer prices rose 0.4% on the month against 0.3% expected, per Toobit.
Bitcoin dipped to about $72,700 intraday and about $723M of crypto bets were forcibly closed, per Why It Moved.

stories.title: MSCI will drop Strategy from its indexes on 30 November; Strategy pushes back
stories.summary: MSCI confirmed it will remove Strategy (MSTR), the biggest bitcoin-holding company, from its global indexes, including MSCI USA, after the close on 30 November. It is the first review under MSCI's new rule for 'non-operating companies'. Funds that copy MSCI indexes will have to sell their Strategy shares. Strategy has said MSCI's proposal was 'misguided, flawed' but not material to its business, per Yahoo Finance.
points: SharpLink is on MSCI's watch list, per investingLive.
Index trackers hold about 13M Strategy shares, roughly 3.1% of its basic shares, by Strategy's own figure, per investingLive.
Strategy closed Wednesday at $122.35 and slipped 0.85% after hours to $121.31, per Yahoo Finance.
JPMorgan's earlier estimate was about $2.8B of index-fund selling, up to $8.8B if other index providers follow; it was based on MSCI's earlier proposal, per Yahoo Finance.
The removal does not force Strategy to sell any of its 850,364 BTC, per KuCoin and Yahoo Finance.

stories.title: Money keeps leaving bitcoin funds, but the outflows are shrinking
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had a fourth straight day of net outflows on Tuesday, though each day's outflow was smaller than the one before. These funds are the main way US investors buy bitcoin through a brokerage account, so steady selling removes a key source of demand. Wednesday's figure was not yet published when this was written.
points: Daily net outflows: $430.2M on 5 Nov, $411.9M on 6 Nov, $201.1M on 9 Nov and $95.0M on 10 Nov, per TFTC's ETF tracker.
On 10 Nov BlackRock's IBIT lost $78.2M and Fidelity's FBTC $36.8M, while Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in $20.0M, per TFTC.
The four days together lost about $1.14B, per The Coin Republic.
Since launch the funds have taken in about $55.4B net, per Toobit.

briefs.title: Nvidia falls after hours on reports about Jensen Huang
briefs.summary: Nvidia fell as much as about 8% after hours on reports its board was considering replacing Jensen Huang; no decision has been announced, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Russia sets 22 Nov start for crypto trading on exchanges
briefs.summary: Retail investors will be limited to BTC, ETH and USDT, capped at 300,000 rubles a year per intermediary, per Coin Turk.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks fastest since 2022
briefs.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell about $14.2B over 30 days, the largest drop since 2022, per Glassnode data cited by KuCoin. Fewer stablecoins means less cash parked in crypto ready to buy.

briefs.title: Deutsche Bank goes live with crypto custody
briefs.summary: The bank launched custody for BTC, ETH, USDC and other assets for its clients, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE tokenized stock platform set for 23 Nov
briefs.summary: The launch date was confirmed and OKX's OKB token rose about 5% in 24 hours, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken's parent ask to back the CFTC in court
briefs.summary: They asked a federal court for permission to file a brief supporting the CFTC's approval of never-expiring futures on single stocks; DRW, Jump and Paradigm joined them, per The Block.

briefs.title: Germany wants crypto accounts in its account-lookup system
briefs.summary: The proposal would add crypto accounts to the system authorities use to look up bank accounts, per KuCoin.
